about.heroTitle: We are the Feast of Esther.
storyParagraphs: Feast of Esther is an annual divine assignment organized by Pastor (Mrs.) Folu Adeboye, wife of the General Overseer of the Redeemed Christian Church of God.
Since its inception in 2002, the gathering has expanded from Nigeria across Africa, Europe, and North America, strengthening women in ministry through worship, prayer, and fellowship.
about.missionTitle: For such a time as this.
about.missionIntro: Feast of Esther 2026 will be held June 18th–20th, 2026 at Dallas/Fort Worth Airport Marriott, 8440 Freeport Parkway, Irving, Texas, USA, 75063.
about.missionBody: A forum where women in ministry learn to accomplish their calling, stand in the gap, and impact the church for revival in the nation.
